join.label: JOIN THE HUB
join.headline: Join the Young AI Leaders.
join.intro: You can join our Discord and participate in our events without a membership. You don't need a technical background — AI is interdisciplinary, and diversity is a key strength of our community.
join.details: Anyone between the ages of 18 and 30 can apply to become an official member of Young AI Leaders for up to four years. Further information on membership can be found in the global Community Charter, which is binding for all members.
join.call: Interested? Then simply send us your application via email! It should include your name, date of birth, a personal statement explaining your motivation (maximum 250 words total), and a resume / CV (as a PDF attachment).

about.label: ABOUT
about.headline: Young Talents.
about.description: Founded in 2025, the Young AI Leaders Dortmund are part of the global AI for Good initiative. We bring together a diverse community of students, researchers, and professionals to collaborate on responsible AI projects that support the UN Sustainable Development Goals. Supported by strong connections to local partners like the Lamarr Institute and RC-Trust, our hub combines technical expertise with open, inclusive collaboration. Together, we create innovative projects with real-world impact in Dortmund, the wider NRW region, and beyond.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.hosting: Our website is hosted via GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA). When you visit our pages, GitHub automatically collects log data (e.g., IP address, browser type, time of access) to ensure the security and functionality of the service. We do not have access to or process this data ourselves.
privacy.analytics: We use Google Analytics to monitor page activity and improve our website. For more information about how Google Analytics collects and processes data, please visit the official Google Terms & Conditions pages. A cookie is created to store your consent preferences as obtained from the cookie banner.
privacy.links: Our website also contains links to external third-party websites (e.g., AI for Good, Discord, LinkedIn). When you click on these links, you leave our website. The operators of those linked sites are solely responsible for their content and the processing of personal data.
privacy.summary: Beyond this, we do not use cookies, tracking, or analytics tools, and no further personal data is processed.
